# bcryptrocks

Nim wrapper over Solar Designer's [`crypt_blowfish`](https://github.com/openwall/crypt_blowfish), created as a drop-in replacement for [bcryptnim](https://github.com/runvnc/bcryptnim) with better Windows compatability as the main goal.
